items.title: Manuel Joseph "Moose" Zanco Interview, 1959-11-25
items.q: the mayor, Mayor Morrison, had some sort of a party over there, you know, for his personal friends and he invited the band to play

ctx.x: And how many jobs did you play?

Well, we went down there primarily for this parade, you see, this carnival parade. But while we were down there, the mayor, Mayor Morrison, had some sort of a party over there, you know, for his personal friends and he invited the band to play, see, so he used our band. All in all, I would say we made about three sessions other than the parade, see. We had a session going up in our hotel room one night and I think that was the best music we'd ever played. Of course nobody was there to listen to us but it really…
Were there any other bands from new audience down there?
